product.description: Corporate Charge Card for consolidating employee expenses that provides improved cash flow and increased visibility and control, while offering employees a range of premium rewards and travel benefits.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Employees over 18 years of age that are Australian citizens or permanent residents can apply for a Corporate Card under the Corporate Card program.
Must be a Director or Controller of the business.
Applications are assessed based on the information provided and are subject to credit approval.

features.additionalInfo: The Amex App lets you quickly and easily manage your Card Account anytime, anywhere.
Fraud Protection Guarantee, protecting you from unauthorised charges made on your Account.
Terms, conditions, cover limits and exclusions apply.

2 points for every dollar spent on international purchases, airlines, dining and hotels, 1.5 points for every dollar spent on all other spend, except government where you will earn 1 point per $1 spent.
Get pre-sale tickets and access to some of your favourite events, and enjoy the Amex Entertainment Lounge before the show at select venues. With Amex, you can dive into unforgettable experiences.
Up to 51 days to pay for purchases.
Priority Pass™ complimentary airport lounge access worldwide.
Access to AMEX Centurion Lounge locations with up to 2 guests.
Complimentary digital subscription to The Australian Premium.
Card Members receive complimentary Plaza Premium lounge visits worldwide with up to 2 guests.
Card Members receive complimentary Delta Sky Club visits worldwide when flying Delta.

Primary Card Members receive complimentary Virgin Australia Lounge access with up to one guest at selected domestic airports when flying on an eligible Virgin Australia flight, subject to availability and eligibility criteria.
Every time you book with Fine Hotels + Resorts you’ll receive a range of complimentary benefits, including room upgrade (when available), breakfast for two, and 4pm late checkout.

Receive up to US $100 hotel credit and room upgrade (when available) at selected hotels in The Hotel Collection when you book two consecutive nights’ stay through American Express Travel. Subject to availability and eligibility criteria.

Enjoy complimentary annual membership to ALL Accor+ Explorer, which entitles you to a host of benefits including two 'Stay Plus' complimentary nights stay each year (each complimentary night must be booked in conjunction with a paid night) and 30% off your dining bill, for up to 10 guests at over 1,600 participating Accor Hotel restaurants. Enrolment required.
Card Members receive complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Status
Card Members receive Hertz Five Star Status including discounts and upgrades when available.
Receive one complimentary car-class upgrade whenever possible and increased savings on car rentals at participating locations worldwide. Enrolment required.
Access 1,550 Airport Lounges in more than 140 countries, including the Centurion® Lounge, Escape Lounges, Priority Pass™ Lounges and more
